request.prompt: Create ONE original square full-bleed opaque hand-painted landscape for a Vietnamese friends travel journal in Ta Xua, Son La. Watercolor and matte gouache on fine visible paper tooth, delicate colored-pencil edges. It must belong to a whimsical mountain travel scrapbook, with authentic painted pigment texture, absolutely no photography, no 3D, no glossy rendering, no vector clipart. No people, portraits, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, frames, borders, collage or multiple panels. Composition must work both as a centered wide crop and centered tall phone crop: keep the upper and middle two thirds pale, airy, softly washed and uncluttered for dark jade handwritten website headings and seven portrait stickers. Soft distant mountains can be visible there but no busy contrast. Floral accents cluster toward the lower fifth and lower side edges, with some tiny blooms near the lower center to survive the phone crop. Keep flowers delicate and small, never a giant central bloom. No sun disc. This is an imaginative illustrated landscape, not a documentary photograph. MI: A pink cosmos morning meadow floating above a sea of clouds. Dominant flower colors are rose pink, fuchsia and blush, with muted raspberry stamens, sage green stems and just a few tiny ivory accents. Paint loose translucent watercolor washes and fine graceful pencil stems. A curving grassy ridge enters from the lower left and curls gently into the mist at lower right; soft blue-jade mountain islands sit low behind it. Upper sky is pale rose-tinted cool pearl and mist blue. Pink light grazes the cloud rims. A soft breeze gives cosmos petals an airy, joyful feeling. Predominantly pink flowers, not mixed multicolor flowers. Tender transparent pigments and a light open sky distinguish this scene.
